name: doe-designs
description: Build a design of experiments (DOE) run matrix from your factors, approved levels, responses, run budget and batch limits. Get screening designs (full and fractional factorial, Plackett-Burman, definitive screening), response surface designs (central composite, Box-Behnken) and mixture designs, with blocks, run order, centre points and a plain alias and estimability explanation. Check an existing design for confounding and runs outside approved operating bounds.

interface.shortDescription: Build a DOE run matrix within approved bounds
